Name: Pride Giant Tamagotchi Egg TVs
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
[u]Description:[/u]
[list]
[*]Retextures the budget TV so it looks like a giant tamagotchi
[*]Config to retexture the TV channels so they all match the LCD display
[*]PC and Mobile compatible
[*]If you like this check out my other mods! I also do commissions and have a [url=https://ko-fi.com/asteriskart]Kofi[/url]
[/list]
[u]Quick start[/u]
[list=1]
[*]For the Content Patcher version you need version ﻿﻿1.19 of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]CP[/url]﻿ or higher
[*]Extract this mod and it's required mods into your mods folder (if you are confused check out [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started#Getting_started]this guide[/url]﻿)
[*]It's ready to play!
[/list]
[u]Config guide[/u]
[list]
[*]'true' will retexture the TV channels so they look like they've on a green LCD screen, 'false' will disable this feature
[*]Next to 'Design' type the number of the texture you'd like, which can be found in the assets folder
[/list]
[u]Tips and tricks[/u]
[list]
[*]Alternative Textures conversion is also bundled into my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10400]Big Interior Mod[/url], so if you have the furniture pack from that mod you don't need this one
[*]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11781]this mod[/url]﻿ to have the TV take up less floor space

[/list]

Manifest.Name: (AT) TamagoTV
Manifest.Description: Alternative Textures content pack for furniture
